comparison.scope:
Compare captured official callback custom data with Native scheduler state.

The official audit groups samples by callback outcome. At each timestamp and trade,
select samples with the largest filled-order count, then require their custom data
to agree before comparing the Native end-of-candle open position. Closed positions
are outside this supplemental stream; their trade surface has separate parity.

validation_scope_notes: Docker-backed changed-signal tests run separately to avoid the managed Docker lock.
Ruff is scoped to engine code, tests, and new evidence scripts; the untracked donor strategy is preserved unchanged.
The final fingerprint check follows the last Native rebuild.

The full suite ran while integration work continued; affected source, Native runtime, X7 golden, and archive replay modules were rerun after their relevant final changes. The main-run failure and its passing recovery are retained explicitly.
limitations: Fixtures certify only their sealed sources, configurations, markets, and intervals; synthetic transformations are disclosed in recipes.
The original BTC Spot fixture has zero trades and is not position-management evidence.
Portfolio full-state projection excludes arbitrary custom_data; separate retained official audits cover 9148 observed long/short open-position boundaries.
Advanced non-safe parameters and virtual custom fee overrides fail closed.
This matrix does not certify arbitrary exchanges, multi-pair concurrency, or every liquidation path under X8.
Validation performed on Linux; no cross-platform Required CI or PR publication was requested.
